The '''Jazbina system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jazbina/Legends|Jazbina]], which was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Jazbinan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was located in the [[Lostar sector/Legends|Lostar sector]], a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].
